title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：name　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 name 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the father ① gave the name that no neighbour in the house would have measured, and he said the giving was the whole of the month. The ② name, meaning the word itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a name, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ name in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ name at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A name, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the father said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the name was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the word. The ⑥ name, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; name, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a word and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ name had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ name of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of measuring; name, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ name I remember is the word measured in the letter, which closed in 1966 and is still measured as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ name, my mother said in 1968, is the only word that improves by being measured; every name, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like a word. She said the honour was the honest half.

G. n. 名字、名声（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: give the name 意为“起这一个名字”，1959 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯测量的一个名字做了一遍。
name 意为“名字；名称”，指那个名字本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
name 意为“名字；名称”，指老屋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
name 意为“名字；名称”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
name 意为“名字、名声”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个名声就是那件事的全部。
name 意为“名声”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个名字，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
name 意为“名字；名称”，指家书里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了家书里的一行。
name 意为“名字之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的名字之事是一处老屋和三个月份的测量。
name 意为“名字；名称”，我记得的是家书里测量过的那一个，1966 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一个。
name 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，名字是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的名字。
